name: previous_x
retail_semantics: Previous integer X; used for navigation rollback

name: previous_y
retail_semantics: Previous integer Y; used for navigation rollback

name: direction_degrees
retail_semantics: Float direction angle initialized from direction*45

name: movement_direction_mask
retail_semantics: Resolved Pickles movement bits: 1 Up,2 Right,4 Down,8 Left; later converted to direction 0..7

name: animation_frame_countdown
retail_semantics: Per-entity animation countdown; decremented during updates and reset to delays including 50/100/150; gates are seeded to 50

name: movement_speed
retail_semantics: Float movement speed / per-update movement magnitude

name: temporary_target_timer
retail_semantics: Temporary wander/target countdown; e.g. 200 after food change or Scruffty distraction
